description: This file defines the server-side code-behind logic for the Basket index page in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application. It manages basket display, item addition, quantity updates, and user identification via cookies and authentication.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: PageModel class for handling the Basket page operations such as displaying basket items, adding, and updating quantities.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to display the current basket for the user.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add an item to the basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdate
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to update quantities of items in the basket.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a user identifier via cookies or authentication to associate the basket with the user.
